title: For prayer with the Word of God
note: Let us pray that praying with the Word of God be nourishment for our lives and a source of hope in our communities, helping us to build a more fraternal and missionary Church.

title: For children with incurable diseases
note: Let us pray that children suffering from incurable diseases and their families receive the necessary medical care and support, never losing strength and hope.

title: For disarmament and peace
note: Let us pray that nations move toward effective disarmament, particularly nuclear disarmament, and that world leaders choose the path of dialogue and diplomacy instead of violence.

title: For priests in crisis
note: Let us pray for priests going through moments of crisis in their vocation, that they may find the accompaniment they need and that communities may support them with understanding and prayer.

title: That everyone might have food
note: Let us pray that everyone, from large producers to small consumers, be committed to avoid wasting food, and to ensure that everyone has access to quality food.

title: For the values of sports
note: Let us pray that sports be an instrument of peace, encounter, and dialogue among cultures and nations, and that they promote values such as respect, solidarity, and personal growth.

title: For respect for human life
note: Let us pray for the respect and protection of human life in all its stages, recognizing it as a gift from God.

title: For evangelization in the city
note: Let us pray that in large cities often marked by anonymity and loneliness we find new ways to proclaim the Gospel, discovering creative paths to build community.

title: For the care of water
note: Let us pray for a just and sustainable management of water, a vital resource, so that everyone may have equal access to it.

title: For mental health ministry
note: Let us pray that the mental health ministry be established throughout the Church, helping to overcome the stigma and discrimination of persons with mental illnesses.

title: For the proper use of wealth
note: Let us pray for the proper use of wealth, that not succumbing to the temptation of selfishness, it may always be put at the service the common good and solidarity of those who have less.

title: For single-parent families
note: Let us pray for families experiencing the absence of a mother or father, that they may find support and accompaniment in the Church, and help and strength in the Faith during difficult times.
